expo.name: Bolid Tester

updates._comment: EAS Update / OTA (docs/release.md). The owner runs `eas init` + `eas update:configure` once, which replaces the placeholder URL with `https://u.expo.dev/<projectId>` and fills `extra.eas.projectId`. checkAutomatically ON_ERROR_RECOVERY: the app never checks silently at launch, only when the user taps More > Check for updates (docs/privacy-policy.md). The channel header is for the Gradle-built CI APK; EAS Build overrides it per eas.json profile.

infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bolid Tester connects to your OBD2 Bluetooth adapter to read vehicle diagnostics.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Bolid Tester connects to your OBD2 Bluetooth adapter to read vehicle diagnostics.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Bolid Tester connects to a Wi-Fi OBD2 adapter on your local network.

web._comment: Web target (plan 28, docs/web.md): a static single-page export (`npx expo export --platform web --output-dir web-build`, never dist/) deployed to GitHub Pages by .github/workflows/web.yml. `single` emits one index.html with expo-router routing client-side; the workflow copies it to 404.html so GitHub Pages answers deep URLs (e.g. /bolid_tester/settings) with the app.

experiments._comment: GitHub project pages serve the site under /bolid_tester/ (plan 28). Native builds ignore baseUrl.

expo._comment: Phase 2 scaffolding. The native build (Expo prebuild / EAS) is done on a developer machine; not exercised in the cloud container.
